title: Sukkah 3a — Practice Quiz
source: Questions and correct answers taken directly from the Dafyomi Advancement Forum quiz for Sukkah 3 (dafyomi.co.il/sukah/quiz/su-qz-003.htm), questions 1–2.

questions.q: Assuming a sukkah's minimum size is "his head, most of his body, and his table" — does "kitoniyyot" (small side-rooms) answer why the Elders said nothing about Queen Helene's sukkah?
questions.explain: Rashi cites both readings and leans toward "No" as more likely. But the Gemara's own back-and-forth — Rabba bar Rav Adda's proposal, then Rav Ashi's refinement of it — leaves it as a live dispute between the two, which is why the marked answer is "Machlokes A&B."

questions.q: Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel argue about a ________.
options: Small sukkah with no room for his table
A room for his table inside the house — that isn't actually there
questions.explain: The Gemara's resolution is that they disagree about two separate things at once: the minimum footprint of a small sukkah, and where one may sit in a large sukkah relative to his table.
